## Checklist

- [ ] **Tests:** I added or updated tests, and ran the developer guide's checks and, if I touched the guide, a docs build with no dead links.
- [ ] **Docs:** I updated the guides or READMEs that describe what I changed (and the changelog, if it is user-visible).
- [ ] The theme still renders every block (the starter theme is the reference) and works in light and dark where it supports both.
- [ ] No real organisation's name, logo, imagery or copy: demo content is fictional and says so in code comments.
- [ ] I checked it in a real browser at phone, tablet and desktop widths.
- [ ] **No secrets or personal data:** no passwords, tokens, keys or real people's details in the code, tests, fixtures, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md in the core repository, including the contribution terms.
